calculation.expression: when cross-sectional std(3d returns) > rolling_median_60d(std(3d returns)): -(asset_3d_return - cross_sectional_median_3d_return) / rolling_std_20d(daily_returns)
calculation.description: During elevated cross-asset dispersion, fade each instrument's three-day return relative to the cross-sectional median, scaled by its 20-day realized volatility. Otherwise signal is missing. Signals are cross-sectionally median-centered in the persisted artifact.

validation.regime_notes: Positive one-day IC across 2,199 observations with average 13.05 of 15 instruments; regime slices reported by the validation script were positive, though IC weakened at longer horizon. Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
